edges.reason: Caller address msg.sender is used in executeSwap for fee accounting and event emission.
msg.sender indexes the userFeeCharged mapping.
External ETH transfer completes before userFeeCharged[msg.sender] is updated, enabling reentrant fee manipulation.
executeSwap performs the external ETH transfer before writing fee state.
Treasury state variable is passed as the recipient of the ETH fee.
Caller-controlled target address is the delegatecall destination.
Caller-controlled calldata is executed via delegatecall in the contract context.
Return data of the delegatecall is stored in returnData.
decodeRevert is invoked from executeSwap on delegatecall failure.
The success flag of the delegatecall controls the branch calling decodeRevert.
Return data bytes are decoded by decodeRevert.
_result bytes are decoded into a revert reason string.
_value is the ETH amount forwarded by the low-level call.
_to is the recipient of the low-level ETH call.
Owner-supplied treasury address is written by setTreasury.
onlyOwner modifier guards setTreasury.
setTreasury writes the treasury state variable, controlling the fee recipient.
Cached old treasury value is used for the TreasuryChanged event.
Constructor argument initializes the treasury address.
Constructor writes the initial treasury state variable.
onlyOwner compares owner() against the caller.
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
_setOwner writes the ownership state variable.
newOwner argument is written into _owner by _setOwner.
newOwner argument flows through transferOwnership.
onlyOwner restricts transferOwnership to the current owner.
onlyOwner restricts renounceOwnership to the current owner.
transferOwnership calls _setOwner to update ownership.
renounceOwnership calls _setOwner with the zero address.
Cached old owner value is used for the OwnershipTransferred event.
delegatecall executes arbitrary external bytecode in the context of SwapFeeCharge.
The ETH transfer can re-enter executeSwap before fee state is recorded.
